title: Assistant Manager Accounts
description:
**JOB TITLE** - Assistant Manager – Finance and Accounts

**DEPARTMENT** - Finance and Accounts Department

**REPORTS TO** - Head – Internal Controls

**PURPOSE OF ROLE**

The Assistant Manager – Finance and Accounts owns the accuracy and timeliness of Gokul Oottupura's books.

He/she is responsible for ensuring that entries are passed correctly, books are closed on schedule, statutory dues are met and reports are ready for further analysis.

The role combines execution and supervision, ensuring reliable transactions, clean closes, compliance without lapses and enforced controls.

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Tally Entries -** Pass or review accounting entries with correct ledger, cost centre and tax treatment such as:

* Accounts payable entries - purchase invoices, GRN-to-invoice matching, debit/credit notes, vendor payments
* Sales Entries
* Petty cash entries
* Expense entries: utilities, rent, repairs and maintenance, manpower, outlet and Head Office expenses.
* Maintain fixed asset entries: capitalization vs. revenue decision, additions, transfers between outlets, disposals and depreciation

Team leadership: assign work between the Senior and Junior Accountants, set monthly deadlines, review their entries before posting or finalizing, ensure nothing sits in suspense or unallocated heads; guide and give input for their appraisals.

**2. Month- End Close**

● **Cut-off and pre-close (last week of month)**: circulate the close calendar; confirm all outlets, Central Kitchen and Procurement have submitted invoices, GRNs, transfers and petty cash vouchers by the cut-off date.

● **Transaction completeness:** all purchase, expense and sales/collection entries posted; GRN-to-invoice and unbilled receipts reconciled with Procurement; inter-outlet and Central Kitchen transfers matched on both sides.

● **Accruals, provisions and depreciation:** book expenses incurred but not billed (utilities, rent, manpower, audit fees, etc.); prepaid expenses and their amortization; provisions for bonus, gratuity and leave as per policy; post depreciation, update the asset register and capitalize completed projects.

● **Reconciliations:** bank (all accounts); outlet cash, card/UPI and aggregator settlements (daily or weekly); petty cash counts; vendor statements for key suppliers and payables ageing; intercompany/related-party balances; and statutory ledgers (GST, TDS, PF/ESI) against returns and challans.

● **Stock and inventory:** obtain closing stock values from Stores/Costing, reconcile them to the books, follow up on variances and post the stock adjustment entries.

● **Trial balance review:** scan for abnormal balances, wrongly mapped ledgers, and unusual month-on-month movements; clear queries with the entry owners.

● **Lock, handover and checklist:** freeze the period in Tally; hand over the final trial balance, P&L and Balance Sheet to Costing Department and the Partners within the agreed working-day deadline; maintain a signed month-end checklist showing who completed each step and when.

**3. Year-end close**

● All month-end steps, plus a full ledger scrub: ageing review of debtors, creditors and advances, and write-off or write-back proposals for approval

● Confirmation of balances (vendors, banks, loans, deposits) and physical verification support for stock and fixed assets.

● Year-end provisions, deferred items, and 43B(h) / MSME payment-status review.

● Audit coordination: act as point of contact for statutory, tax, GST and internal auditors; prepare schedules and working papers, respond to queries and track audit adjustments to closure.

● Pass audit adjustments, finalize financial statements, and carry forward opening balances correctly.

**4. Budgeting**

● **Annual budget:** coordinate preparation with Costing, Procurement, HR and outlet heads; compile the expense, capex and cash-flow budgets in agreed formats.

● **Monthly payment budget:** consolidate vendor, statutory, payroll, rent and loan payments due; prepare the weekly/monthly payment plan against expected cash availability and obtain Partner approval; ensure MSME vendors are paid within the 45-day limit (Section 43B(h)).

● Monitor actual payments against the budget and report variances to the Partners; flag shortfalls early.

**5. Statutory compliance**

● GST: GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B, GSTR-2B reconciliation, annual return and reconciliation statement (GSTR-9/9C), e-invoicing and e-way bill requirements where applicable.

● TDS/TCS: correct deduction, timely deposit, quarterly returns (24Q/26Q/27Q), Form 16/16A issue, and tracking of lower-deduction certificates.

● Income Tax: advance tax computation support and payment, return and tax audit report support, notices and assessment responses (with the consultant).

● Payroll-linked and local levies: confirm PF, ESI, Professional Tax and Labour Welfare Fund deposits and returns are made on time (with HR).

● Company/entity filings: support the consultant with ROC/MCA or other entity filings, where applicable.

● Maintain a compliance calendar with due dates, owners and filing evidence; no interest, penalty or late fee should arise from Accounts.

**6. Documentation and recording**

● Ensure every entry has supporting documents (invoice, GRN, approval, proof of payment) filed and retrievable.

● Maintain digital records of statutory filings, challans, returns, agreements and audit working papers, with retention as required by law.

● Process improvement: keep accounting policies and SOPs updated; push for automation in Tally (bank import, GST reconciliation, voucher templates) and report recurring errors back to their source.

**7. General accounting controls**

● Oversee segregation of duties, approval limits, and master-data controls.

● Tally governance: own the chart of accounts and ledger master (no new ledger without approval); review user access and ensure back-ups, audit trail and period locks are enabled and used.

● Run routine control checks: duplicate invoices, payments without approval, cash limits, advances not adjusted.

● Report control exceptions and recommend corrective action to the Partners.

**8. Coordination with other departments** including but not limited to:

● **Procurement and Central Kitchen:** GRN and invoice flow, rate differences, returns and credit notes, transfer pricing between units.

● **Outlets and QSR:** daily sales and collection reporting, petty cash, cash deposit, expense vouchers.

● **Costing:** provide a timely, clean ledger so that analysis is accurate; resolve mapping queries.

● **Banks, lenders and external parties:** maintain loan schedules and interest bookings; prepare data for bank stock statements, renewals and compliance certificates; handle statement, confirmation and data requests from banks, landlords, consultants and authorities.

● Chase and escalate non-compliance with documentation and cut-off timelines.

**REQUIREMENTS AND SKILLS**

**Technical (must have)**

1. Strong working command of Tally (Prime/ERP 9): vouchers, masters, GST and TDS configuration, reports, period locking and user rights.

2. Sound knowledge of Indian accounting standards and the double-entry cycle, including accruals, provisions, depreciation and reconciliations.

3. GST and TDS/TCS: rate structure and input tax credit rules for restaurants and food businesses, GSTR-1/3B/2B reconciliation, annual return, TDS/TCS provisions and return filing; basic knowledge of Income Tax, PF, ESI and Professional Tax.

4. Advanced Excel: lookups, pivot tables, reconciliation and data-cleaning formulas.

5. Familiarity with the GST portal, TRACES and the income tax portal.

6. Basic knowledge of cash-flow forecasting and budgeting methods.

**Technical (good to have)**

7. Experience with an ERP or POS integration with Tally, and with e-invoicing.

8. Exposure to the Companies Act / LLP Act compliance and tax audit requirements.

**Behavioural**

9. **Accuracy and deadline discipline:** catches errors before they reach the books; treats the close calendar and statutory due dates as fixed.

10. **Team leadership:** able to guide, review and develop the team and hold them accountable.

11. **Controls mindset:** comfortable saying no to a non-compliant entry, even from a senior colleague.

12. **Communication and integrity:** clear, firm and courteous when chasing outlets, Procurement, the Central Kitchen and other departments; handles sensitive financial and partner information responsibly

13. **Languages:** fluent English; Malayalam preferred for working with outlet and vendor teams in Kerala.

**WORK EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS**

**Work Experience**

1. Minimum 5 years of working in the field of accounting, finance, and taxation, with at least 3 years as Senior Accountant, Team Lead or Assistant Manager in a supervisory role.

2. At least 4 years in the accounts function of a multi-outlet business with high transaction volume: restaurants, hotels, QSR chains, food manufacturing, retail or FMCG are all suitable.

3. Must have personally done month-end and year-end closes, not only reviewed them.

4. Preferred: experience in a restaurant, hospitality or food business, where cash, card and aggregator settlements, perishable purchases and outlet-wise books are routine

**Educational Requirements**

5. Minimum Requirement - B.Com with M.Com or MBA (Finance); or B.Com with CA Inter / ICWA (CMA) Inter.

Preferred - Qualified CA / CMA preferred.

Pay: ₹35,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Kochi, Kerala: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Application Question(s):

* Minimum 5 years of working in the field of accounting, finance, and taxation, with at least 3 years as Senior Accountant, Team Lead or Assistant Manager in a supervisory role.
* At least 4 years in the accounts function of a multi-outlet business with high transaction volume: restaurants, hotels, QSR chains, food manufacturing, retail or FMCG are all suitable.
* Must have personally done month-end and year-end closes, not only reviewed them.
* Preferred: experience in a restaurant, hospitality or food business, where cash, card and aggregator settlements, perishable purchases and outlet-wise books are routine.
* Minimum Requirement - B.Com with M.Com or MBA (Finance); or B.Com with CA Inter / ICWA (CMA) Inter.

Preferred - Qualified CA / CMA preferred

Education:

* Master's (Required)

Experience:

* Assistant manager Accounts : 8 years (Preferred)

title: Odoo Implementation Lead / Functional Consultant
description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced **Odoo Implementation Lead** to drive our ERP implementation projects and support our growing team. In this role, you will take ownership of end-to-end project delivery, mentor junior functional consultants/business analysts, and act as a strategic point of contact for clients.

This is a dynamic, "playing coach" role ideal for a senior functional expert who wants to lead a team while staying close to the Odoo ecosystem, assisting with complex client requirements, pre-sales demos, and resource optimization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Project Delivery & Governance:** Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of Odoo implementation projects, ensuring milestones are met on time, within scope, and up to quality standards.
* **Team Leadership & Mentoring:** Direct, guide, and upskill a team of junior functional consultants and business analysts, fostering their professional growth.
* **Training Management:** Design and lead functional training programs for internal team members and clients during project onboarding or rollouts.
* **Pre-Sales & Complex Demos:** Provide senior-level functional support during the sales cycle, stepping in to lead demonstrations for complex workflows or high-value client prospects.
* **Client Relationship & Account Health:** Serve as a primary point of contact for project clients. Conduct monthly/regular review meetings for project delivery and employee augmentation accounts to ensure high client satisfaction and resource performance.
* **Resource Allocation:** Optimize team utilization across dedicated implementation projects and resource augmentation assignments.

\*

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 4 to 6 years of hands-on experience in Odoo ERP implementation, with a proven track record of successful end-to-end rollouts.
* **Odoo Expertise:** Deep, comprehensive functional knowledge of core Odoo modules (e.g., Accounting, Inventory, Manufacturing, CRM, Sales, Purchase).
* **Leadership Skills:** Prior experience leading, mentoring, or managing functional consultants or business analysts.
* **Communication:** Exceptional English communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to manage client expectations, handle escalations, and deliver technical presentations clearly.
* **Methodology:** Strong understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Scrum, or traditional) tailored to ERP delivery cycles.

Pay: Up to ₹1,400,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have leading end-to-end Odoo ERP implementations as a Project Lead or Functional Consultant?"
* "Which versions of Odoo (e.g., v15, v16, v17, v18) have you successfully deployed, and have you ever led a major version upgrade project?"
* Have you directly managed a team of internal Odoo developers and functional QA testers, or do you typically work as a solo consultant?"
* Have you independently handled an Odoo implementation from requirement gathering through Go-Live?
* Have you conducted business requirement gathering and mapped client requirements to standard Odoo functionality?

* Have you conducted Odoo product demos or presentations for prospective clients?

* What is your current/expected salary and notice period?

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Kakkanad, Kochi, Kerala

title: Tech Consulting - Oracle - FIN - Financials - Functional Consultant - Manager
description:
Location: Kochi

Other locations: Anywhere in Country

Salary: Competitive

Date: Oct 28, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1746260

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Oracle Fusion - Finance Functional - Manager**

  

**Job Summary:**

  

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Finance Functional Manager with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience and strong finance-domain and accounting knowledge. The role requires substantial hands-on implementation and support experience across Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Fixed Assets (FA), Cash Management (CM), General Ledger (GL), Oracle Fusion Tax and Subledger Accounting (SLA). The successful candidate will lead functional delivery, solution design, client workshops and project teams while remaining actively involved in configuration, testing, deployment and post-go-live support.

**Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

  

* Lead end-to-end Oracle Fusion Finance implementations, rollouts, upgrades and support engagements, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.
* Provide hands-on functional leadership across AP, AR, FA, CM, GL, Fusion Tax and SLA, including configuration, solution validation and issue resolution.
* Analyse client finance and accounting requirements and map them to standard Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials processes and controls.
* Design enterprise structures, chart of accounts, ledgers, accounting calendars, business units, tax structures, subledger accounting rules and financial transaction flows.
* Lead fit-to-standard workshops, requirement gathering, process design, solution walkthroughs and stakeholder sign-offs.
* Prepare and review functional design documents, configuration workbooks, process flows, test scripts, training materials and operating procedures.
* Manage finance integrations with Procurement, SCM, Projects, HCM, banking, tax, reporting and external applications.
* Drive CRP, SIT, UAT, data migration, cutover, go-live and hypercare activities, including reconciliation and defect resolution.
* Apply strong accounting knowledge to validate journals, period close, reconciliations, statutory and management reporting, taxation and audit requirements.
* Manage scope, estimates, plans, risks, issues, dependencies, quality, governance and stakeholder communication.
* Lead, mentor and review the work of functional consultants while collaborating effectively with technical, integration, data and reporting teams.
* Support pre-sales, solutioning, effort estimation, proposals, demonstrations and internal capability-building initiatives as required.

  

**Experience:**

  

* Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in Oracle Financials, with substantial hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials.
* Strong real-world implementation and support experience across AP, AR, FA, CM, GL, Fusion Tax and SLA; candidates must be able to configure and troubleshoot these modules independently.
* Deep understanding of finance and accounting concepts, including procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, record-to-report, asset accounting, bank reconciliation, taxation, period close and financial reporting.
* Experience in at least three full lifecycle Oracle Financials implementations, including at least two Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials implementations.
* Proven experience leading finance workstreams, client workshops, solution design, testing, data migration, cutover and post-go-live support.
* Experience in client-facing delivery, project planning, effort estimation, team management and senior stakeholder communication.
* Experience across major sectors such as government, retail, energy, real estate, oil and gas, and power and utilities is preferred.

  

**Competencies / Skills:**

  

* Strong leadership, customer handling skills and ability to lead and mentor team members.
* Ability to drive projects and teams independently, work under pressure, and meet deadlines.
* Effective communication skills and ability to translate requirements into design documents.
* Excellent organizational, time management, analytical and critical thinking skills.
* Ability to acquire, absorb, and apply complex business knowledge to problems quickly.
* Ability to follow well-defined release management processes and stay focused on release priorities.
* Must have a valid passport for business traveling, which involves work at client sites. Willing to work in MENA shift timings (Sunday to Thursday).
* Understanding of AI applications in project portfolio management, including predictive analytics, automation tools, and AI-driven insights.

  

**Education:**

  

* Mandatory qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA), MBA in Finance, ACCA or CMA from a recognised institution.
* Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials certification is preferred.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Hospitality All Rounder
description:
Job description:

* **Title:** **Hospitality All Rounder** (or similar: Guest Relation Executive /Travel Consultant / Guest Service Associate)
* **Mostly Prefer: Freshers** with a background in **Hospitality Management**
* **Location:** Panampilly Nagar, Kochi (full-time, office-based)
* **Core mandate:** Turn leads (calls, messages, emails) into confirmed bookings and maintain strong relationships with clients and guests.
* **Scope:** You’ll be assigned specific holiday-home properties across India and act as the main point of contact for those assets.

Key responsibilities

From your text and similar listings in Kochi, the day-to-day likely includes:

* **Lead conversion**
* Responding to enquiries via **calls, WhatsApp/messages, and email**.
* Explaining property features, pricing, policies, and availability.
* Guiding guests through the booking process and payment.
* **Guest & client relationship management**
* Pre-arrival coordination (check-in instructions, special requests, upsells).
* During-stay support and issue resolution.
* Post-stay follow-up, feedback collection, and encouraging repeat bookings.
* **Escalation handling**
* Managing complaints (cleanliness, maintenance, host issues, refund disputes, etc.).
* Coordinating with operations/housekeeping/maintenance teams to resolve issues quickly.
* Documenting escalations and ensuring they don’t recur.
* **Inventory & listing management**
* Updating availability, rates, and restrictions across channels (website, OTAs, social media, internal tools).
* Ensuring photos, descriptions, and policies are accurate and consistent.

Typical requirements for this profile

* **Excellent English communication** (spoken & written) – mandatory.
* Comfort with **phones, WhatsApp, email**, and basic office software.
* Ability to learn and manage **booking systems, property dashboards, and simple website/OTA updates**.
* Strong **customer service orientation**, patience, and problem-solving skills for escalations.
* Preference for candidates with exposure to **hospitality, travel, real estate, or sales**

If you’re preparing an application or interview:

* Emphasize any experience in:
* **Sales / lead conversion** (targets, follow-ups, closing deals).
* **Customer support / guest handling** (hotels, homestays, travel agencies, e-commerce support).
* Using tools like Excel/Google Sheets, basic CMS, or any booking/CRM software.
* Basic coordination with property owners/managers for block dates or maintenance.
* **Digital & communication tasks**
* Handling basic updates on **website listings, social media handles**, and possibly responding to reviews/messages on platforms like Instagram/Facebook/Google.
* Using CRM / property management software to track leads, bookings, and guest history.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person
